text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans from U.S. Bunge at a tender on Friday, traders said. Delivery was slated for March.

CORN SALE - South Korean feed mill companies bought 36,000 tonnes of Chinese corn from Toepfer through private negotiations. Arrival of one 12,000-tonne shipment was slated by April 20, the next 12,000 tonnes by April 30 and the last 12,000 tonnes by May 10 to the western port city of Kunsan.

BARLEY SALE - Tunisia on Friday confirmed it bought four lots of 25,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley each at $136.64 per tonne cost and freight at a tender on Thursday. The state buying body Office des Cereales said shipment dates are May 10-20, June 10-20, July 10-20 and August 10-20.

WHEAT TENDER - Algeria rejected all offers to supply durum wheat at a tender and is expected to launch a new one, European grain traders said. Algeria tendered on Thursday for three 50,000-tonne shipments of durum between mid-March and the end of April and said it would consider offers from the U.S., Canada or Syria.

WHEAT TENDERS - India's state-run State Trading Corporation said it would decide in the next two days on offers received for its tender to import 50,000 tonnes of wheat. STC last week tendered for the wheat imports, due for shipments by the end of February and for arrival no later than March 31. The tenders closed on Wednesday.
- The CCC said it was seeking up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 soft white wheat, 13.5 pct moisture, for Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for Feb 20 to March 15.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender February 5 for 2,170 tonnes of No.2 hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, for donation to Uganda. The donation will be made under the World Food Program and will be shipped March 1-25.

- Egypt's main wheat buyer said Tuesday it was back in the market, seeking bids for 50,000 tonnes of Argentine, U.S. or French wheat for loading in March or April. The deadline for bids is 8 a.m. local (0600 GMT) on Feb 1.
- Results are awaited on Bangladesh's tender for 100,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian or Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by Feb 21, traders said.

WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, for delivery in two lots of hard and soft wheat, an official for the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender, for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, will close on February 7.

CORN TENDERS - The CCC said it seeks to buy 27,170 tonnes of No. 2 yellow corn for donation to Uganda, Mozambique and Angola. Offers are due on Feb 5. The CCC said 10,000 tonnes will be donated to Uganda, 9,260 to Mozambique and 7,910 to Angola. Shipment of all three lots was to be March 1-25.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey will tender Feb 3 to export 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for shipment in February and March, traders said.
SORGHUM TENDERS - The CCC said it would seek 15,000 tonnes of U.S. no 2 or better sorghum, of which 5,000 tonnes would be for donation to Uganda and 10,000 tonnes for Ethiopia.
The CCC said the shipment period for both tenders was March 1-25. Offers for both were due on February 5.

RICE TENDERS - Colombia is preparing to tender for up to 50,000 tonnes of rice to help cover a shortfall in domestic production, Agriculture Ministry sources said. They said a formal announcement regarding the tender was expected to be made by Agriculture Minister Cecilia Lopez sometime next week. The sources said it was not immediately clear what country Colombia would seek to buy the rice from.
Syria's General Foreign Trade Organization for Chemicals and Foodstuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be February 3.
- Iraq will tender on Feb 3 for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain rice under Iraq's "food-for-oil" program. The tender is for two 15,000 tonne positions for April and May delivery.

MARKET TALK - Russia will take delivery of around 25,000 tonnes of Argentinian milling wheat in the next few weeks. A senior grains trade source said Tradigrain bought the cargo for delivery to Russia's Far Eastern port of Vladivostok, adding the delivery marks the first time Argentinian wheat appeared on the Russian market in recent years.

... Malaysia has purchased up to 100,000 tonnes of corn for February and March deliveries with the bulk of the imports from China and is in the market to buy more if prices are attractive, trade sources said.
... The Philippines is to buy 205,000 tonnes of 25 percent grade Thai rice, Foreign Minister Prachuab Chaiyasarn said on Thursday after returning from a trip to Manila.
... - A 57,500 tonne shipment of U.S. maize will arrive in Cape Town harbour on Sunday, the first consignment of offshore maize bought last year by the Western Cape Maize Buyers Association.
